question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed'

question: Which product generated the most revenue from completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product category sold the most units in completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which state has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT state FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the revenue from completed orders in March 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'

question: What is the average order value of completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) t FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: Which city's customers spent the most in completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items oi USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of the Standing Desk were sold in completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed' AND p.name='Standing Desk'

question: Which month of 2026 had the most completed orders? Answer with the month number.
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) FROM orders WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY strftime('%m', order_date) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct customers placed at least one completed order in October 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31'
